author: Telos III
title: Project Phoenix - RS-S11: Create Project Directory for Study 011
abstract: This is the initial setup step for Study 011. It creates the main project directory `storage/telos/repro_studies/study_011_logos_harness` to house all artifacts for this verification study. This ensures a clean and isolated environment for the test.

original_submission.content:
import os
import shutil

STUDY_DIR = "storage/telos/repro_studies/study_011_logos_harness"

def main():
    print(f"--- Setting up directory for Study 011 ---")
    if os.path.exists(STUDY_DIR):
        print(f"Directory {STUDY_DIR} already exists. Cleaning it.")
        shutil.rmtree(STUDY_DIR)
    
    os.makedirs(STUDY_DIR)
    print(f"Successfully created clean directory: {STUDY_DIR}")
    print("--- Setup complete ---")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
